title: Cosmic Plasma Sphere
description: A glowing plasma globe with vibrant neon pink, cyan, and yellow electrical arcs radiating from a central orb. The transparent glass sphere sits on a metallic pedestal with a small golden sailboat visible inside, set against a dark cosmic background with colorful flowing energy ribbons and floating luminous particles.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal plasma globe with vibrant neon pink, cyan, blue and yellow electrical tendrils arcing from a bright central sphere to the glass surface. A small golden sailboat floats inside the orb. The globe rests on a dark metallic pedestal with base. Cosmic dark background filled with flowing colorful energy ribbons in magenta, orange and teal, glowing particles and aurora-like effects, mystical and luminous atmosphere.
